title: The Economics of Reserve Accumulation in Georgia: An Independent Assessment of Costs, Benefits, and Optimal Reserve Adequacy
author: Nikoloz Oniani
research_question: Did the National Bank of Georgia's large-scale foreign-currency purchases prevent the Georgian lari from appreciating, and were the resulting economic costs justified by the benefits of reserve accumulation?
scope: One intervention episode, one economic counterfactual, and its consequences.
episode_status: Administrative evaluation window registered in R0; exact first execution/program boundaries remain an R1 gate. September 2026 is the last acquired intervention month, not a proven program end. Different accounting series have earlier cutoffs.
stage: R0 completed: retrospective design registration, provenance/concordance and claim records, reproducibility repairs and isolated-checkout verification; R1-R7 economic evidence gates remain open
